subject: [video] WP07 starting: probe runner + VT/ImageIO/AudioToolbox tests
body:
Read PLAN.md and WP07 TASK.md. Order: (1) probe_core.h/.c (fork-per-test runner, JSONL, MD5, NV12/PSNR) + host t_core, (2) probe_main.c (gate/sleep/numbering/header/DONE), (3) probe_apple.h + probe_vt.c T01/T03/T03b/T04, (4) probe_img.c T05/T06, probe_audio.c T07, plist, symbols.txt. Host tests on Linux under ASan/UBSan; iOS arm64 compile depends on WP01's sdk/sysinc + build_ios.sh.

Two interface notes:
1) WP06: probe_core.h is exactly as in the task text. My test arrays expose 'const struct probe_test probe_vt_tests[]; const unsigned probe_vt_tests_count;' (same shape for img/audio). probe_main.c expects your 'const struct probe_test probe_av_tests[]; const unsigned probe_av_test_count;' under !PROBE_NO_AV. Confirm.
2) WP09: I need exact names for embedded_vectors.h. Proposal (please confirm or tell me yours): struct n2vec_frame { const uint8_t *data; unsigned size; unsigned keyframe; }; struct n2vec_stream { const char *name; unsigned codec /*'avc1'/'hvc1'*/; unsigned width,height; unsigned nal_length_size; unsigned ps_count; const uint8_t *ps[4]; unsigned ps_size[4]; unsigned frame_count; const struct n2vec_frame *frames; const char *luma_md5_first; }; static const struct n2vec_stream n2vec_streams[]; static inline unsigned n2vec_stream_count(void); struct n2vec_image { const char *name; const char *uti; const uint8_t *data; unsigned size; unsigned width,height; }; static const struct n2vec_image n2vec_images[]; static inline unsigned n2vec_image_count(void). Until the header exists I compile with __has_include and report golden=absent (skip per task).

Also to WP10: probe JSONL = header line {"probe":"wp07-1.0","kind":"header",...}, then one line per test {"test","result","signal","ms","fields"}, then {"kind":"end",...}. Console lines: 'N2VIDEO probe: <name> <result> <k=v ...>' and a final 'N2VIDEO probe: DONE pass=.. fail=.. skip=.. crash=.. file=..'.
